top_signals.title: Bill Ackman Discusses Daughter's Care, Recovery
top_signals.summary:
Bill Ackman, CEO and founder of Pershing Square joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." They discuss the recovery of Ackman's daughter after she suffered a brain hemorrhage.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
